newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: OAU conflict management group to meet on Zaire.
newsitem.headline: OAU conflict management group to meet on Zaire.

text.p: The Organisation of African Unity (OAU) said on Wednesday that a ministerial meeting of its 17-nation conflict prevention group would be held in Addis Ababa next week to discuss the conflict in eastern Zaire.

An OAU statement said the meeting would take place on Monday to review a resolution passed by a seven-nation African summit in Nairobi on Tuesday calling for the deployment of a neutral force in Zaire.
The intention was to try to save the lives of 1.2 million Rwandan and Burundian refugees facing the risk of famine.

The meeting would also consider proposals for safe corridors and temporary sanctuaries inside Zaire to facilitate humanitarian assistance and the repatriation of refugees to their countries of origin, the OAU said.
Member states from the Great Lakes Region as well as other countries neighbouring Zaire would attend the meeting, it added.
The statement did not make clear whether Burundi, under OAU sanctions following a military coup in July, would attend the gathering.

Members of the Central Organ of the OAU Conflict Prevention, Management and Resolution include Cameroon (chairman), Algeria, Comoros, Congo, Ethiopia, Gabon, Guinea, Malawi, Mauritania, Mozambique, Nigeria, Saharawi Arab Democratic Republic, Tanzania, Togo, Sudan, Zambia and Zimbabwe.
